Most teams start their day chasing phone calls: a tech can't make it, a customer is upset, or a SLA clock is ticking. At Slatebridge, we face this every Tuesday morning when a technician calls out sick.

Auto-Rebalance moves their work across the remaining team in under a minute, respecting skills and locations to keep our Service Level Agreements (SLAs) on track—eliminating 45 minutes of re-planning by phone. Today, it's available to all customers at no extra cost.

Want to see how it works? Reply here or visit us directly for a live demo.
